text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. This time, 
Seiun Sky is in the spotlight and sure to 
be closely marked during the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, despite the circumstances, Seiun 
Sky kept her eyes on Grass Wonder and the 
other strong rivals—and smiled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it is, might as well enjoy 
taking down strong rivals. Devising his 
schemes, Seiun Sky prepared for the race.
